description: Javedan Corporation Limited is a Pakistani real-estate development company incorporated in June 1961 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its business is Naya Nazimabad, a gated development on Manghopir Road in Karachi that the company describes as a live, work and play community with education, healthcare and sports facilities. The Arif Habib Group is the company's largest shareholder and business manager.
headOffice: 1st Floor, Arif Habib Center, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: jcl.com.pk (home, about-us, contact block) and nayanazimabad.com/who-we-are/, /apartments/, /commercial/ (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Naya Nazimabad — residential development
products.summary: A gated community on Manghopir Road, Karachi, developed on a live, work and play concept, with water, gas and electricity available in the vicinity.

products.name: Globe Residency Apartments
products.summary: Four- and five-room apartments in Naya Nazimabad, with dedicated parking.

products.name: Peace Apartment — shops and showrooms
products.summary: Commercial units of 200 to 1,000 sq ft on the upper ground floor, aimed at grocery stores, pharmacies, salons, cafes and brand outlets.

products.name: Community amenities
products.summary: Jama Masjid, a club house and gymnasium, cricket and football stadiums, and the Ali Habib Medical Center.
